A row says the arc contains (or lacks) the elicitors of a reward cycle: anticipation, consummation, load, warmth, drive, recovery. It does not say a listener will feel anything (docs/NEUROCHEMICAL-AFFECT-PLAN.md)

the consummation pool peaks at 0.15 at 0.5 s (want 0.5); the hit changes the level by -0.1 dB (want 3).
